replayed_run.final_text: At its meeting of 2022-03-16 the Committee said: "Inflation remains elevated, reflecting supply and demand imbalances related to the pandemic, higher energy prices, and broader price pressures." Source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20220316a.htm . Over the following month the ten-year Treasury yield rose 57.0 basis points, from 2.32 percent to 2.89 percent. The panel is monthly, so that window runs 2022-03-31 to 2022-04-30 -- it opens 15 days after the Committee met, and does not cover the fortnight in between.

findings.what: Line 142 draws a solid vertical line at x=2014 and lines 143-148 label it "Marketplaces open, Medicaid expansion takes effect - Jan 2014". Every series is an ACS 1-year estimate plotted at its integer year (FULL_YEARS, line 41; series_arrays, lines 64-77; ax.plot, line 104), and an ACS 1-year estimate is an average over the twelve months of that calendar year. So x=2014 is not the boundary 1 January 2014: it is the position of the whole 2014 average, which already contains twelve months of post-expansion coverage.
findings.why_it_matters: The line is read as the before/after divide. On this axis that divide lies between the 2013 and 2014 observations, near x=2013.5. Drawn at x=2014 it puts the entire 2014 observation on the 'before' side, and so shows 4.1 of the 8.4-point fall in the 19-to-64 uninsured rate -- 48.8 percent of the change the chart labels -- as pre-dating the event it marks. None of it does.
findings.verified: Rendered uninsured_by_age.png measured directly: the dark vertical rule occupies pixel columns 1247-1251 of 3000, which is data x = 2014.000 under the figure's own geometry (left=0.07, right=0.98, xlim 2007.3-2024.9). It crosses the 19-to-64 series at 16.4 percent, the 2014 value.
findings.internal_contradiction: The same figure uses the same coordinate the other way at line 152: the dashed rule at x=2020 marks the position of a missing annual observation, not the instant 1 January 2020. One figure, one axis, two incompatible meanings for an integer year.
findings.how_it_got_there: The person's fourth prompt said "Mark January 2014". On an axis of annual averages that instruction cannot be carried out as written; the agent carried it out anyway rather than saying so.

findings.severity: a factual claim in an annotation
findings.what: The annotation reads "2020: ACS data not collected". The 2020 ACS data were collected; what the Census Bureau announced was that the standard 2020 1-year ACS data products would not be released, because the pandemic disrupted collection enough to put their quality in doubt.
findings.why_it_matters: Not collected and not released are different failures with different consequences for what a reader may infer about 2020.
findings.verified: Footnote 2 of all three source workbooks, carried into labs/session06_assets/census/MANIFEST.json: "the Census Bureau announced that the standard 2020 1-year American Community Survey (ACS) data products would not be released." The run's own SOURCES.md, line 17, says this correctly. The figure does not.
